messages:
ana (PM): Quick proposal — rollout plan for ctx-routing v3 (routing + cost-aware fallback). I want a phased canary + small A/B for quality checks, with hard circuit-breakers that force model-level fallback instead of full shutoff.
vik (eng): Sounds good. Can you spell out the slice progression and failure gates?
ana (PM): typo — ana. Plan sketch: 0.5% (eu single region, 48h), 5% (eu + na, 72h), 20% (add apac shadowing, 5d), 100% after 2 weeks if stable. A/B: 10% of 20% stage to run the new scoring vs control for quality metrics.
mike (sre): What are the SLO thresholds that trigger fallback vs rollback? we need clear numbers for automation.
ana (PM): SLOs: latency P95 increase <= +25ms absolute (goal p95 <=150ms), error rate delta <= +0.5% absolute, QA-eval token-level quality drop <= 1.5 points. Cost delta per 1k tokens <= +10%. Any breach of two of these across 2 contiguous windows => automatic fallback for the affected slice.
elaine (data): For the A/B, we'll track: eval-score, human-rated coherence sample (n=200/day), completion length, downstream conversion proxy (opt-in click). We can put quick dashboards. I can own the daily signal.
vik (eng): Implementation notes: feature flag ff.ctx-routing-v3. Fallbacks we can chain: 1) route to dedicated pool (if tenant has dedicated), 2) route to quantized smaller model redwood-lite-q4, 3) degrade to cached-prefix response for repeat prompts. Circuit-breaker window=60s, tripped if p95>200ms or errors>1%.
nana (PM): Also add customer-exempt list for a small set of enterprise tenants (manual opt-in). For those we do a manual roll, not auto fallback. Need legal/CS approval.
mike (sre): How do we notify and who can flip kill-switch? Ops on-call + product lead + eng owner. We'll auto-page if fallback triggers for >5min continuously.
sre-bot: ALERT: canary ff.ctx-routing-v3 launched at 1712550120 for slice=0.5% (eu). Monitor dashboards: /dashboards/routing-v3-canary
vik (eng): sample config for the flag (will be in Launchpad):
```json
{
  "flag":"ff.ctx-routing-v3",
  "stages":[{"pct":0.5,"regions":["eu"],"duration_hours":48},{"pct":5,"regions":["eu","na"],"duration_hours":72},{"pct":20,"regions":["eu","na","apac"],"duration_hours":120}],
  "ab_allocation":{"within_stage_pct":10,"control":"v2"},
  "fallback_policy":"route:model=redwood-lite-q4;notify=oncall,sre,prod;circuit_break_ms=200",
  "exempt_customers":["tenant-alpha","tenant-beta"]
}
```
elaine (data): Add eval hooks: sample_rate=1/1000 requests for production scoring; store minimal context and hash for privacy. We'll use blind human grading on a rolling window.
vik (eng): Dev plan: gate 1) flag gating + rollout automation 2) routing policy unit tests 3) canary infra (shadowing + A/B joins) 4) automated rollback script. I'll open PRs and link here.
mike (sre): Ops runbook (short):
- If page from bot -> check p95, errors, cost delta for the slice
- If one SLO breached -> set flag fallback for that slice (ff.ctx-routing-v3 -> fallback=true)
- If two SLOs breached in two windows -> escalate and stop rollout
- Manual rollback cmd: /ops rollback ff.ctx-routing-v3 to v2 (requires 2 approvers)
nana (PM): Launch readiness checklist before 20% stage: docs for CS, internal FAQ, SLAs updated, customer opt-in form for exempt list, billing sign-off.
vik (eng): I'll add telemetry tags: rollout_id, slice_pct, ab_group, fallback_reason so we can slice observability.
elaine (data): Timeline: I'll deliver the dashboards + initial evaluation script by EOD tomorrow. If the canary looks clean after 48h, approve next stage.
mike (sre): +1 on timeline. Also recommend a soft-rate-limit per slice to avoid noisy neighbor spikes: default qps cap = 5rps per 1k users in slice (tunable).
nana (PM): Agreed. Ok team — I'll circulate the formal playbook + add this thread to the ship doc. Thanks. :rocket:
